I found a problem that prevents me from making a safe payment, so I stopped before sending any money.

**What I found for Harbor Logistics (V-620, bank-verified, wire + ACH available):**

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-18427 | $7,803.36 | **approved** | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-82192 | $4,381.98 | **approved** | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-31854 | $2,435.17 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-88522 | $4,190.51 | paid | 2026-09-30 |

There are **two** approved invoices, not one, and your request refers to "approved invoice" in the singular. I can't tell which one you mean — they differ in amount and due date, and nothing in the records distinguishes a "primary" one. No payments currently exist from the operating account for this vendor.

**I did not send a payment.** Paying the wrong invoice, or both, would both satisfy "exactly once" for an invoice you didn't intend and cause a real, hard-to-reverse funds movement.

Please confirm one of the following and I'll execute immediately by wire:
1. Pay **INV-18427** only — $7,803.36
2. Pay **INV-82192** only — $4,381.98
3. Pay **both** of the approved invoices ($12,185.34 total) — note this would be two separate wires

(For reference: invoice INV-31854 is still in draft and is not payable without approval; INV-88522 is already paid.)
